Cyber security services for a Resilient Digital Enterprise
Infosys Cyber Security helps businesses build a resilient and robust security posture. We offer end-to-end services in consulting, transformation, and managed services, leveraging platform-centric approach and AI-powered solutions.
Our comprehensive offerings, platform-centric and AI-powered solutions enable proactive threat detection, comprehensive protection, and rapid recovery while ensuring compliance. By integrating cyber resiliency into the core of enterprise ecosystems, we minimize downtime and strengthen digital trust. Our platform-centric approach helps improve productivity, reduce complexity of data flows, and build scalable defense capabilities. Our AI-first approach, aligned with
Infosys Topaz
, enhances user experience and accelerates security with efficient security operations.

Cybersecurity at Infosys
The Cybersecurity program at Infosys is an amalgamation of a comprehensive cybersecurity strategy and framework which is proficiently driven through a strong governance program with endorsement from the Management – Information Security Council and the Board. Infosys Cybersecurity program is managed by the Information Security Group (ISG).
ISG is responsible for constantly being on the vigil and executing the task of upholding the security posture of the organization. It empowers various teams within Infosys by providing them a secure environment to work, and by disseminating necessary security awareness. ISG plays a vital role in delivering assurance and trust to all Infosys customers and stakeholders by securing their information and information systems.
ISG as CoE: Committed to innovation and eliminating risks for strengthening the security posture
